title: Insatiable
summary: INSA'TIABLE, adjective insa'shable. [Latin insatiabilis; in and satio, to satisfy.] Incapable of being satisfied or appeased; very greedy; as an insatiable appetite or desire; insatiable thirst.

inlines.v: INSA'TIABLE, adjective insa'shable. [Latin insatiabilis; in and satio, to satisfy.] Incapable of being satisfied or appeased; very greedy; as an insatiable appetite or desire; insatiable thirst.
